Pahirapan ring makalabas ng EDSA sa bahagi ng Scout Borromeo dahil sa bumper-to-bumper na daloy ng mga sasakyan.

Nagmistulang parking lot naman ang bahagi ng Kamuning Flyover southbound dahil sa tindi ng traffic ngayong hapon. | via Jamie Santos/GMA Integrated News

The Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) has added more U-turn slots in Marcos Highway, in hopes of avoiding another "Carmageddon" similar to last weekend's. The MMDA also appeals to malls along the highway to not launch mall-wide sales for now.

Here are the other solutions offered by MMDA to ease the heavy traffic along Marcos Highway.
